member.summary: Represents a group of related APIs.
member.remarks:
Endpoints are grouped by their , which can be set using the WithGroupName extension method on minimal API endpoints or the [ApiExplorerSettings(GroupName = "...")] attribute on controller actions. Endpoints without an explicit group name are placed in a single group with a .
Note that MapGroup does not set the group name for its endpoints. It only applies a route prefix. To assign a group name to all endpoints in a route group, chain WithGroupName on the MapGroup call.
